derivation: a member at rank r of N beats ~r/N by construction, so the rate must fall in q; the SHAPE and LEVEL are what is measured
world: ⭐ A A SCALE-FREE q BUYS A LOW RATE — q=90 admits family members at 0.0250, at or below twice the operator's nominal 0.025. So q IS selectable on evidence, and R1037's 'declared, not fixed' can be narrowed to a DEFAULT of 90 with its cost stated.
limitation: a low rate would not make q RIGHT; that is construct validity and needs a criterion vocabulary this release does not carry (R1028)
